listing.shortDescription: Use core JSONX and JXM workflows in Claude Code.
listing.longDescription: The JSONX Claude Code plugin packages the core jsonx skill for JSONX and JXM package usage, rendering behavior, examples, tests, and docs. It stays separate from generated UI so teams can install package help without enabling interface-output guidance.

skills.name: jsonx
skills.purpose: Core JSONX and JXM package help.

positiveTestCases.userPrompt: /jsonx:jsonx Review this JXM payload and explain how it renders.
positiveTestCases.expectedBehavior: Loads the core JSONX skill and returns a package-aware explanation.

positiveTestCases.userPrompt: /jsonx:jsonx Create a small JXM example for a React button.
/jsonx:jsonx Help debug a JSONX child rendering issue.
/jsonx:jsonx Suggest tests for a render helper change.

negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Route to the separate jsonx-generative-ui plugin.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: Generated UI belongs to the separate plugin.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: /jsonx:jsonx Connect this to ChatGPT Apps SDK.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Explain that hosted renderer setup belongs to the generative UI plugin.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: Apps SDK wiring is outside the core plugin.

negativeTestCases.userPrompt: /jsonx:jsonx Add GSAP to the core package.
negativeTestCases.expectedBehavior: Keep GSAP out of the core npm package.
negativeTestCases.whyNotComplete: Animation belongs in the renderer layer.

releaseNotes: Initial community submission of the core JSONX Claude Code plugin.
manualBeforeSubmit: Review the latest claude-validation-evidence.json and rerun claude plugin validate ./plugins/claude-jsonx-plugin before final submission.
Run a local session with claude --plugin-dir ./plugins/claude-jsonx-plugin and smoke test /jsonx:jsonx.
Confirm marketplace publisher and support details in the submission form.
